highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Looking for a university with strong academics and a vibrant community? California Baptist University (CBU) might be your choice. CBU offers over 100 undergraduate majors and more than 40 graduate programmes across various fields like Health Science, Business, Engineering, Music, Psychology, and Liberal Arts.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: The university offers over 150 student-led organisations, so there’s always something for you to do. If you're an international student, you’ll find cultural events and other programmes, so you’ll feel at home.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
CBU has several on-campus housing options, including traditional dorms, apartment-style housing, and suites. You’ll find modern and safe residence halls like Magnolia Crossing and Simmons Hall close to the campus. The university also helps you find housing in the Riverside area.

You can also download our app and check out the Stays feature for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The Annie Gabriel Library is your go-to spot for research, reading, or quiet study. It offers access to physical books, e-journals, databases, and academic support tools.

Sports
Whether you want to join a team or just work out, you’ll get access to top-tier facilities like the Fowler Events Centre, fitness centres, aquatics, and intramurals. The university is home to the Lancers, a competitive NCAA Division I team

Laboratory
If you choose science and engineering fields, CBU offers state-of-the-art laboratories and research equipment to help you with hands-on learning and research.

Cafeteria
At the campus, you’ll find the Alumni Dining Commons offers a wide range of cuisines, including gluten-free and vegan options. There are also cafes and grab-and-go spots scattered across campus.
